plugins.name: workiq
plugins.description: WorkIQ for Microsoft 365 mail, calendar, Teams, files, SharePoint, people, Planner and Business Applications. Use retrieve with source-based strategy selection to find evidence and summarize locally. Use ask only for a requested Copilot or named-agent answer; use entity tools for specific reads and operations, with confirmation before mutations. When both plugins are installed, prefer workiq-preview only if its installed version is higher than workiq's; otherwise prefer workiq.

plugins.name: microsoft-365-agents-toolkit
plugins.description: Toolkit for building and evaluating Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents — scaffolding, JSON manifest development, capability configuration, and eval workflows.

plugins.name: workiq-productivity
plugins.description: WorkIQ productivity skills powered by the local WorkIQ CLI — read-only insights across email, meetings, calendar, Teams, SharePoint, projects, and people.
